latestVersion.changelog:
CertainLogic Onboarding Wizard v2.1.0

- Free tier now includes all core features formerly marked "Pro": setup scripts, post-install verification, weekly checkups, and team onboarding export.
- Documentation fully rewritten for clarity, highlighting honest limitations, recommended usage, and error handling.
- Expanded starter stacks and guidance for all user types, including beginners and business users.
- Major improvements to example output, error messaging, and next-step recommendations.
- Emphasizes transparent, actionable guidance and best-practice onboarding flows.
